coverage: 54 callback registration cases: nine capacity/reallocation/aliasing modes, three callback values including zero, and two selected entrypoints.
48 connected floating query/initialization cases: six x87 control words, absent module/query and feature0/1. Actual probe, decoder/encoder and initialization helpers execute.
Capacity/reallocator callbacks may mutate globals; compare exact raw arguments/events, all declared memory, full results, preserved registers and stack cleanup.
Floating initialization final function pointers checked against each compiled MAP symbol; literal embedded labels remain raw watched DWORDs.
Windows imports use explicit isolated IAT traps; no host API is invoked. Final full x87 state compares.
limitations: Finite normal-return emulator behavior and empty initial x87 stack only. Hardware erratum and pending hardware exceptions are not established.
Allocator capacity/reallocation and Windows module/feature APIs are controlled external boundaries.
Initialized callback targets are checked as addresses; their later arbitrary indirect behavior remains unproven.
